system.description:
Were you built to be the hero you are today? Perhaps. But it's undeniable that you were created by someone or something. As a constructed being, you don't have the same experiences or expectations as similar organic creatures, but you still feel drawn to the role of hero.

Qualities

Assign a d12 and a d6 to two of these qualities:

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.qualities.Item.ogM64mcFILG1tI9V]{Alertness}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.qualities.Item.yfrz6TSCgB2EzH4E]{Science}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.qualities.Item.8sdeTQgqsZuFExgc]{Technology}

• Select from Physical qualities category

Principle

Choose an Expertise principle.

Power Source

Roll d10, d10, d6 for power source selection.
